name: Nine Lives Stealer
description: A longsword with nine small notches filed into its guard, some of them filled with lead.
body:
## What it does

Any sword can carry this hunger; this one is a longsword. It strikes truer and harder than a plain sword.

## Life stealing

It holds 1d8 + 1 charges when found and never regains them. When you hit a creature with fewer than 100 hit points on a 20, it makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or dies as the sword tears out its life force, and each death spends a charge. Constructs and undead are untouched.

features.name: Life Stealing
features.text: On a 20 against a creature with fewer than 100 hit points, not a construct or undead, it makes a DC 15 Constitution save or dies, and its death spends a charge.

charges.last: it keeps its bonus but steals no more lives
